question: In December 2022, Government of India launched Grih Pravesh scheme. This scheme aims to provide benefits to the residents of ____ areas.
solution:
The correct answer is __**both rural and urban**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Grih Pravesh scheme** was launched by the Government of India in December 2022.
 
• The scheme aims to provide benefits to the residents of **both rural and urban** areas.
 
• It focuses on ensuring housing for all by providing financial assistance for the construction or renovation of homes.
 
• Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries can receive subsidies and grants to improve their living conditions.
 
• The scheme is part of the government's broader mission to enhance the quality of life for citizens across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)** is another housing scheme that aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor with a target to build 20 million affordable houses by March 2022.
 
• The **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs** is responsible for the implementation of these housing schemes in urban areas, while the **Ministry of Rural Development** oversees the schemes in rural areas.
 
• The government has also introduced various other initiatives like **Swachh Bharat Mission** and **Smart Cities Mission** to improve urban infrastructure and sanitation.
 
• These initiatives collectively aim to ensure a better standard of living and to make urban and rural areas more sustainable and livable.
